highlights.summary:
May 24, 2020: Admission applications are open to all programmes.

ICFAI, Meghalaya was established in 2006 by the Government of Meghalaya under the provisions of the Institute of Chartered Financial Analysts of India University Act, 2005. ICFAI boasts of offering world-class, innovative, career-oriented professional postgraduate and undergraduate programs through inclusive technology-aided pedagogies to equip students with the requisite professional and life skills as well as social sensitivity and high sense of ethics.

The ICFAI Group has been recognized as a Great Place to Study in India by the House of Commons, London, the United Kingdom in 2014.

ICFAI has been awarded as the Best University in Meghalaya in CCLA by Education Leaderships in 2007. ICFAI University has been awarded the Pan India Educational Excellence Award in the category of Leading Private University in India for Business Management, Technology, and Law Courses by the Brands Academy, New Delhi.

ICFAI offers various bachelor’s and master’s programs in the field of management, science and technology, law, hospitality & tourism management, information technology, and other areas.

ICFAI Admission Process is done online. However, payment of Rs 300 can be made either through debit/credit card or through DD drawn in favor of ‘The ICFAI University, Meghalaya.

The admission to ICFAI UG and PG programmes is made through the screening of applications and interviews. While evaluating students for admission, due weightage is given to their academic distinction, awards in sports/cultural events, debates, quizzes, and other extra co-curricular activities.

There is a special provision for admission of students belonging to the State of Meghalaya in any course of ICFAI University, Meghalaya or a constituent college, within the State of Meghalaya, which is not less than 25% of seats in each course/discipline subject to the students meeting the minimum qualifying requirements referred to above.

The duration period of BBA, BCA, and BA (Eco-Hons) courses is three years whereas the BTTM and Bachelor of Hotel BHM programmes are offered for four years. However, all the PG programmes are offered for two years. Candidates seeking admission to ICFAI programmes can refer to below-mentioned details:

ICFAI Institute offers various courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels in the streams of Arts, Commerce, Travel and Tourism Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, and Computer Application. ICFAI offers various PG level courses to the candidates aspiring for Higher Studies in the streams of Commerce, Travel and Tourism Management, Business Administration and Computer Application.  Mentioned below are the key courses along with their eligibility criteria and fee structure:

ICFAI Placements are managed and headed by the designated training and placement wing. The training and placement wing monitors the training and placement activities on a full-time and continuous basis. The team evaluates student performance levels and ensures relevant preparation for their corporate placements

ICFAI also provides its students with the Internship Program. The Internship programme is undertaken either during summer or in the final semester for the UG programmes and after Semester-II for the MBA programme and is faculty-supervised. The internship programme is an attempt to bridge the gap between the professional world and the academic institutions.

ICFAI Scholarships are awarded to many students based on merit every semester.
